#Summary Statistics

```{r Monthly.Tbill.Data, echo=TRUE}

library(lubridate)

data <- Monthly.TBill.Data

summary(Monthly.TBill.Data)

dates <- mdy(as.character(data$observation_date))
yield_pct <- as.numeric(data$DGS1MO)

valid <- !is.na(dates) & !is.na(yield_pct)
dates <- dates[valid]
yield_pct <- yield_pct[valid]

order_rows <- order(dates)
dates <- dates[order_rows]
yield_pct <- yield_pct[order_rows]

month_id <- as.integer(format(dates, "%Y")) * 12 +
            as.integer(format(dates, "%m"))


monthly_return <- (yield_pct / 100) / 12

wealth <- cumprod(1 + monthly_return)
running_peak <- cummax(c(1, wealth))[-1]
drawdown <- wealth / running_peak - 1

n <- length(monthly_return)

statistics <- data.frame(
  first_observation = format(dates[1], "%m/%d/%Y"),
  last_observation = format(dates[n], "%m/%d/%Y"),
  observations = n,
  cumulative_return = tail(wealth, 1) - 1,
  ending_value_from_1000 = 1000 * tail(wealth, 1),
  CAGR = tail(wealth, 1)^(12 / n) - 1,
  annualized_volatility = sd(monthly_return) * sqrt(12),
  maximum_drawdown = min(drawdown),
  Sharpe = NA_real_)

print(statistics)

```
